given_when: Guest opens mobile Shop and picks enabled product
then_required_proof: Can browse; paid render prompts phone OTP; no account data exposed

given_when: Upload poor-light/cropped/multi-person image
then_required_proof: Actionable rejection **before** any reservation/debit

given_when: Personal image, consent unchecked or permission false
then_required_proof: Render quote rejected; no provider invocation

given_when: Unsupported garment or disabled jewellery category
then_required_proof: Not offered/charged; safe reason displayed

given_when: Verified shopper approves fixed-price quote
then_required_proof: Single render status chain, original + AI label + fit limitation + zoom

given_when: Same render POST retried 10 times with identical key
then_required_proof: One canonical job, one reservation, one final debit

given_when: Two associates draw on the same low-balance tenant wallet
then_required_proof: At most available amount reserved; no negative balance/double spend

given_when: Model timeout, invalid output or job failure
then_required_proof: No net token cost, safe retry and refund/release visible

given_when: Duplicate/late gateway webhooks arrive
then_required_proof: Tokens credited exactly once after verification; failed payment never credits

given_when: Buyer selects standard vs bulk pack
then_required_proof: Base, savings, total, tokens and purchase confirmation match immutable price version

given_when: Business owner onboards in India
then_required_proof: Email OTP, one tenant, optional GSTIN, proper issued invoice available

given_when: Owner revokes associate
then_required_proof: Associate immediately loses merchant session/catalog spend; owner retains control

given_when: Tenant A guesses tenant B's item/render/wallet/invoice IDs
then_required_proof: No content, balance, image URL, usage or tenant existence leaked

given_when: Showroom customer finishes; next customer uses Back/Reload/old URL
then_required_proof: Prior photo/result hidden and unresolvable, cleanup scheduled

given_when: Customer opts in enquiry with exact item and phone
then_required_proof: Enquiry shown to correct merchant; receipt names item and next follow-up

given_when: User reports/removes preview
then_required_proof: Report tied to result; private asset unavailable on deletion; complaint tracked

given_when: Admin toggles category/model, pack price and tenant with reason
then_required_proof: Only approved routes used for new jobs, effective dates honored, audit written

given_when: Consumer tries using merchant owner credentials in admin login
then_required_proof: Denied; admin password+MFA separate; audit and throttling operate

given_when: Product has no verified seller URL
then_required_proof: Enquiry, not invented Buy button/checkout; source item always accessible

given_when: Jewellery result fabricates stones/changes shape in quality review
then_required_proof: Reject/not release affected output; disable item/category pending fidelity review

given_when: Guest consented image reaches TTL / owner deletes
then_required_proof: Revoke access immediately, remove object asynchronously, preserve legally necessary audit only

given_when: B2C promo credit issued once
then_required_proof: Purchased/promo balances and validity distinct; no duplicate promo on repeat OTP

given_when: Admin reports use B2C/B2B filter and date range
then_required_proof: Totals reconcile with underlying jobs/payments/ledger, no real customer photo

given_when: Long provider outage during quoted/held render
then_required_proof: User sees progress -> failure and funds restored, no orphaned reservation

given_when: UI tested in phone/tablet/desktop and keyboard/screenreader
then_required_proof: Main actions accessible; selection/errors not color-only; dark Mirror contrast checked

given_when: Customer chooses neutral adult mannequin instead of own photo
then_required_proof: Renderable only for supported categories; no avatar customization or personal consent bypass

given_when: Signed-in customer opens/deletes recent results
then_required_proof: Only own delivered recent previews listed and removed; no mood boards

given_when: User uploads one valid product reference instead of SKU
then_required_proof: Product clearly labelled as nonmerchant concept, supported category only

given_when: Merchant owner adds, updates, unpublishes 10–30 real pilot products
then_required_proof: Published display follows tenant ownership, no inventory/branch sync

given_when: Shop displays retailer-listed product beside AI render
then_required_proof: Source product and generated illustration unmistakably distinguished

given_when: Shopper presses thumbs down with wrong-color reason
then_required_proof: Feedback attached to correct render without exposing private result

given_when: Jewellery item with merchant dimensions visualized
then_required_proof: UI says approximate dimensions, never asserts calibrated scale or gold weight

given_when: Wallet has promo/paid balance and insufficient funds
then_required_proof: Price, spendable balance and top-up guidance visible; no negative spend

given_when: Account switches among entitled offerings/form factors
then_required_proof: One core billing/identity, separate B2C/B2B shells, disabled features hidden and blocked

given_when: OTP expired, guessed, resent too frequently or used twice
then_required_proof: Login fails safely, limits enforced, legitimate new challenge can verify

given_when: Payment checkout offers provider-enabled India rails
then_required_proof: Actual enabled UPI/card options visible; unavailable rails not falsely promised
